pin_table.function: Allow the core to fetch instructions.
pin_table.description: Allow the core to fetch instructions. If this bit is set low, the core will pause fetching new instructions and immediately halt once any in-flight instructions in the ID/EX and WB stages have finished. A multi-bit encoding scheme is used. See `IbexMuBiOn` / `IbexMuBiOff` in :file:`rtl/ibex_pkg.sv`

pin_table.description: Core has detected a fault which it can safely recover from. Can be used by a system to log errors over time and detect tampering / attack. This signal is a pulse, one cycle per alert.

description: Ibex is a production-quality open source 32-bit RISC-V CPU core written in SystemVerilog. The CPU core is heavily parametrizable and well suited for embedded control applications. Ibex is being extensively verified and has seen multiple tape-outs.
features: The RV32I Base Integer Instruction Set, version 2.1
The RV32E Base Integer Instruction Set, version 1.9 (draft from June 8, 2019)
[sub] C: Standard Extension for Compressed Instructions
[sub] M: Standard Extension for Integer Multiplication and Division
[sub] B: Standard Extension for Bit-Manipulation Instructions
Zicsr: Control and Status Register Instructions
Smepmp - PMP Enhancements for memory access and execution prevention on Machine mode
always enabled in configurations with PMP see :ref:PMP Enhancements<pmp-enhancements>
